name: ollama
description: Local Ollama provider module: the keyless, on-prem /api/chat terminal hop that every cloud provider degrades to, with circuit-breaker resilience and typed output validation.

features.desc: Ollama /api/chat chat (stream: false) with sampling options and typed output validation.
The local endpoint requires no API key (requires_key=false); nothing leaves the host.
LOW/MED route to llama3.2, HIGH/MAX to qwen2.5, chosen from the issue-#9 tier ladder.

provenance.note: Gateway-owned module-catalog entry (issue #349) for the registered `ollama` provider adapter. Pattern only; the resilient local-LLM client and the /api/chat wire shape were re-implemented for this repo's Python substrate, no source file was copied.
